[package]
name = "commonware-mempool"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[dependencies]
# Commonware (consensus + P2P + runtime)
commonware-consensus = "2026.2.0"
commonware-cryptography = "2026.2.0"
commonware-p2p = "2026.2.0"
commonware-parallel = "2026.2.0"
commonware-runtime = "2026.2.0"
commonware-storage = { version = "2026.2.0", features = ["std"] }
commonware-utils = "2026.2.0"

# Mosaik (streams + discovery for transaction dissemination)
mosaik = { git = "https://github.com/zmanian/mosaik", branch = "feature/dynamic-predicate-reevaluation" }

# Shared
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
futures = "0.3"
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter"] }
clap = "4.5"
rand = "0.8"
anyhow = "1.0"
hex = "0.4"
serde_json = "1.0"
